title: Social Media Strategist
description:
Social Media & Content Executive Company: YouthCamping
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Work from Office
 Employment Type: Full-time About YouthCamping YouthCamping is an adventure travel company offering group trips and travel experiences across destinations such as Spiti Valley, Manali, Kasol, Kashmir and more. We are looking for a creative, organised and proactive Social Media & Content Executive to manage our Instagram and Facebook presence, create engaging content ideas and grow our brand organically. Key Responsibilities 1. Content Planning Create and maintain a monthly and weekly social media content calendar. Research travel content trends, competitors and audience interests. Develop creative ideas for Reels, Stories, carousels and posts. Maintain a consistent balance of entertaining, educational, inspirational and sales-oriented content. 2. Reel Scripting & Content Creation Write strong hooks and engaging Reel scripts with clear storytelling. Prepare voiceovers, on-screen text, captions, CTAs and editing instructions. Identify suitable footage from our existing travel videos and photographs. Coordinate with our freelance video editor to ensure timely delivery. Suggest new ways to use existing footage to create multiple pieces of content. 3. Instagram & Facebook Management Schedule and publish content consistently. Manage daily Instagram Stories and maintain an active social media presence. Write platform-appropriate captions and use relevant keywords and hashtags. Respond to relevant comments and identify opportunities to engage with our audience. Keep the profiles organised, updated and aligned with our brand identity. 4. Community & Brand Building Develop content ideas that encourage shares, saves, comments and traveller mentions. Coordinate with our team to collect genuine traveller photos, videos, testimonials and reviews. Create content from real traveller experiences. Develop ideas for collaborations, user-generated content and community engagement. 5. Performance Analysis Track reach, views, watch time, shares, saves, profile visits and follower growth. Identify successful content formats and recommend improvements. Prepare a simple weekly performance report. Focus on organic growth, brand awareness, audience trust and travel enquiries. Requirements Good understanding of Instagram and Facebook content formats. Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills. Good written communication skills. Ability to write engaging Reel scripts and captions. Familiarity with Canva and social media scheduling tools. Ability to coordinate with a freelance video editor. Organised, self-driven and capable of managing work independently. A portfolio of previous social media work is preferred. What This Role Is Not This is not just a posting or account-handling job. You must actively generate ideas, write scripts, plan content and manage execution. Paid advertising and video editing are not the primary responsibilities of this position. Success in This Role The right candidate will help YouthCamping maintain consistent, high-quality social media content, grow its organic audience, strengthen traveller trust and generate more relevant enquiries. To apply: Share your resume and portfolio, including examples of social media accounts, Reels or content calendars you have worked on. Role & responsibilities 

 Preferred candidate profile Preferred Candidate Profile Experience: 13 years in social media management, content creation or digital content marketing. Strong freshers with a relevant portfolio can also apply. Core skills: Creative thinking, Reel scripting, storytelling, caption writing and content planning. Platform knowledge: Good understanding of Instagram Reels, Stories, carousels and Facebook content. Execution: Ability to independently manage a content calendar and coordinate with a freelance video editor. Analytical skills: Ability to track content performance and suggest improvements based on data. Tools: Familiarity with Trello, Google Drive and Canva. Preferred background: Experience working with travel, lifestyle, adventure or consumer brands. Personal qualities: Proactive, organised, self-driven, detail-oriented and comfortable working independently. Portfolio: Must be able to demonstrate previous content work, Reel scripts or social media accounts managed. Key expectation: Someone who can take ownership of YouthCamping's social media from idea generation to publishing, with minimal daily supervision. 

 Perks and benefits 
 Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

Key Skills: Marketing,Digital Branding,Influencing,Branding,Content,Management,Content creation,Influencer Marketing

title: Content Editor (Copy Editing & Visual Review)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title : Content Editor (Copy Editing Visual Review)
Company Name : NewAgeSys IT, (a division of NewAgeSys)
Location : Carnival Infopark, Phase 2 , Kakkanad, Ernakulam
Job Type : Onsite
Shift Timing : 11 AM - 8 PM About the company 
NewAgeSysIT , a division of NewAgeSys, Inc. established in 1994, based at New Jersey, specializes in mobile app development and consulting, helping clients maximize the reach and effectiveness of their business by leveraging the latest technology. Being a full service mobile and web development firm, NewAgeSMB focuses on servicing clients across North America, UK, Europe, Middle East, Singapore and Australia. We accomplish this by creating a long-term relationship with our clients, from brainstorming the initial idea, strategizing the project plan, building and deploying cost effective solutions with a solid foundation of support and maintenance. Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Content Editor to review and refine our business, technical, and marketing content. The primary objective is to improve clarity, readability, tone, and messaging while ensuring the content effectively communicates with its intended audience. The role also includes evaluating supporting visuals for relevance and communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities 
Content Editing Proofreading
Proofread content for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and consistency.
Refine language, sentence structure, and readability while preserving the original meaning.
Improve content flow, messaging, and tone to better engage the target audience.
Identify unclear, repetitive, or ineffective content and suggest improvements.
Ensure consistency with brand voice and professional communication standards.
Content Types Covered
Website pages, landing pages, and blog articles
Newsletters and client announcement emails
Case studies, white papers, and industry reports
Marketing collateral and other business communications Visual Content Review 
Assess the relevance and effectiveness of images, graphics, illustrations, and videos accompanying the content.
Evaluate how well visuals complement the message and connect with the intended audience.
Recommend improvements to visual presentation, including color schemes, background, tone, or image selection where appropriate.
Suggest alternative visual concepts when existing visuals do not effectively support the content.
Graphic design, image editing, and video production are not required. Required Skills Experience 
Proven experience in professional copy editing, proofreading, or content editing.
Ability to refine content for clarity, engagement, and audience relevance.
Experience with B2B, technology, or professional services content is preferred.
Good editorial judgment and a basic understanding of visual communication. Role Expectations 
The candidate should deliver polished, publication-ready content with clear editorial suggestions and actionable feedback on supporting visuals, within mutually agreed timelines. Our Expectation: We are looking for someone who goes beyond grammar correction and can critically evaluate how effectively both written and visual content communicate the intended message to the audience. 

This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: Mobile application development,Graphics,Content editing,Copy editing,Proof reading,Maintenance,Newsletters,Punctuation

 Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Interior Designer to join our team. This role requires a creative and passionate individual with strong design skills and a proven ability to drive sales. You will be responsible for developing innovative interior design solutions for clients while actively engaging in sales activities to secure projects. Proficiency in both AutoCAD and SketchUp is mandatory for this position. Responsibilities (Design) Client Collaboration: Work with prospective clients to understand their needs, preferences, lifestyle, and budget requirements. Concept Development: Develop creative and functional design concepts, including space planning, furniture layouts, material selections, color palettes, and lighting schemes. Presentations: Prepare detailed design presentations including mood boards, sketches, accurate 2D drawings (AutoCAD), and compelling 3D visualizations (SketchUp)along with material samples to effectively communicate ideas. Technical Drawings: Produce detailed working drawings and specifications for construction and installation using AutoCAD. Sourcing & FF&E: Select and source furniture, fixtures, equipment (FF&E), materials, and finishes, ensuring they meet project requirements and budget constraints.
